CIS_1_1.title: Disable unencrypted legacy management services (Telnet, FTP, WWW, plain API)
CIS_1_1.rationale: Cleartext protocols expose administrative credentials to passive sniffing on transit networks (MITM).
CIS_1_1.finding_passed: All insecure services (telnet, ftp, www, api) are disabled.
CIS_1_1.finding_failed: Insecure services active on the router.

CIS_1_2.title: Audit and disable default 'admin' user account
CIS_1_2.rationale: The default 'admin' account is the primary target of automated dictionary and botnet attacks.
CIS_1_2.finding_passed: Default 'admin' user is disabled or renamed.
CIS_1_2.finding_failed: Default 'admin' user is active on the router.

CIS_1_3.title: Restrict WinBox, SSH and API-SSL exclusively to authorized management subnets
CIS_1_3.rationale: Exposing management ports on 0.0.0.0/0 enables brute-force and zero-day exploitation from the WAN.
CIS_1_3.finding_passed: WinBox/SSH/WebFig access is restricted to authorized management subnets.
CIS_1_3.finding_failed: WinBox/API service is accessible from any address (0.0.0.0/0).

CIS_1_4.title: Disable Open DNS Resolver on WAN interfaces (allow-remote-requests=no or WAN drop)
CIS_1_4.rationale: An open DNS resolver allows the router to be abused in DNS amplification DDoS attacks.
CIS_1_4.finding_failed: Router is configured as an Open DNS Resolver (allow-remote-requests=yes).

CIS_1_5.title: Restrict Neighbor Discovery (MNDP/CDP/LLDP) to trusted management interfaces
CIS_1_5.rationale: Prevents leaking BoardName, RouterOS version, MAC, and IP topology details to untrusted L2 segments.
CIS_1_5.finding_passed: Neighbor Discovery (MNDP/CDP) is restricted to trusted interfaces or disabled.
CIS_1_5.finding_failed: Neighbor Discovery is active on unconfined interfaces.

CIS_1_6.title: Synchronize RouterBOOT firmware with patched RouterOS v7 release
CIS_1_6.rationale: Keeps bootloader and OS microcode aligned against known privilege escalation and CVE vulnerabilities.
CIS_1_6.finding_passed: RouterOS v7.14+ and RouterBOOT are synchronized with official security patches.
CIS_1_6.finding_failed: RouterOS or RouterBOOT firmware requires security patch synchronization.

CIS_1_7.title: Filter Bogon and spoofing prefixes (RFC 1918 / RFC 6890) on WAN ingress
CIS_1_7.rationale: Blocks packets with forged private or unallocated source IPs entering from external transit links.
CIS_1_7.finding_passed: Bogon / RFC 1918 filtering rules are present in RAW or Filter.
CIS_1_7.finding_failed: Missing Bogon / RFC 1918 filtering rules in IP Firewall Filter or RAW.

CIS_1_8.title: Active 3-stage dynamic blacklist defense against SSH/WinBox Brute-Force
CIS_1_8.rationale: Automatically jails offending source IPs attempting repeated authentication failures on management ports.
CIS_1_8.finding_passed: Active 3-stage blacklist defense against Brute-Force attacks is configured in Firewall Filter.
CIS_1_8.finding_failed: Missing 3-stage dynamic blacklists against Brute-Force attacks.

CIS_1_9.title: Enforce modern cryptographic suites (AES-256-GCM / SHA256 / DH Group 14+)
CIS_1_9.rationale: Eliminates weak legacy ciphers (3DES, MD5, SHA1, MODP-1024) vulnerable to cryptographic downgrade.
CIS_1_9.finding_passed: IPsec / WireGuard profiles enforce AES-256 and modern cipher suites.
CIS_1_9.finding_failed: Weak encryption detected in VPN profiles.

CIS_1_10.title: Isolate management plane in a dedicated Management VLAN
CIS_1_10.rationale: Segregates administrative control traffic from subscriber and corporate user data planes.
CIS_1_10.finding_passed: Administrative management is isolated in a dedicated VLAN.
CIS_1_10.finding_failed: No dedicated management VLAN interface detected (e.g., mgmt or vlan99).

CIS_2_1.title: Cryptographic protection for BGP sessions (TCP-MD5 / TCP-AO)
CIS_2_1.rationale: Prevents unauthorized BGP session resets (RST spoofing) and route injection by unauthorized peers.
CIS_2_1.finding_passed: BGP session protection with TCP-AO/MD5 authentication verified.
CIS_2_1.finding_failed: BGP sessions lack TCP-MD5/TCP-AO cryptographic authentication.

CIS_2_2.title: Selective FastTrack preserving Simple Queues and QoS Queue Trees
CIS_2_2.rationale: Unconditional FastTrack bypasses mangle and queue trees, breaking subscriber bandwidth shaping.
CIS_2_2.finding_passed: Selective FastTrack implemented while preserving QoS queue trees.
CIS_2_2.finding_failed: FastTrack bypasses queue trees or lacks marked traffic exclusion.

CIS_ISP_1.title: Drop Bogons / Martians in Firewall RAW prerouting (BCP 38 / RFC 2827)
CIS_ISP_1.rationale: Discards invalid and spoofed source prefixes before connection tracking to protect router CPU.
CIS_ISP_1.finding_passed: Bogon / Martians filtering is active in RAW prerouting chain.
CIS_ISP_1.finding_failed: Missing Bogon / Martians drop rules in RAW for WAN interfaces.

CIS_ISP_2.title: Block external UDP/TCP 53 requests in WAN RAW to prevent DNS Amplification
CIS_ISP_2.rationale: Protects ISP infrastructure from acting as an involuntay reflector in volumetric DNS amplification attacks.
CIS_ISP_2.finding_passed: WAN Open DNS Resolver protection verified.
CIS_ISP_2.finding_failed: Port 53 (DNS) is exposed on WAN interface without filtering.

CIS_ISP_3.title: Mandatory BGP Peering authentication & prefix filter lists
CIS_ISP_3.rationale: Ensures routing table integrity across eBGP/iBGP peers in carrier topologies.
CIS_ISP_3.finding_passed: Cryptographic MD5/TCP-AO authentication present on BGP peers.
CIS_ISP_3.finding_failed: BGP connections detected without TCP-MD5 or TCP-AO authentication.

CIS_ISP_4.title: Control Plane Policing (CoPP) — ICMP/UDP/SYN Flood protection towards router CPU
CIS_ISP_4.rationale: Rate-limits control plane packets in the input chain so transit floods cannot exhaust CPU resources.
CIS_ISP_4.finding_passed: CoPP rate limits configured to protect control plane and CPU.
CIS_ISP_4.finding_failed: No rate-limiting (CoPP) rules detected in input chain.

CIS_ISP_5.title: Bind management services exclusively to Out-of-Band Management VRF
CIS_ISP_5.rationale: Isolates SSH, WinBox, and API sockets from the global routing table used by subscribers.
CIS_ISP_5.finding_passed: Administrative services isolated in Management VRF.
CIS_ISP_5.finding_failed: Management services are bound to the global routing table.

CIS_ISP_6.title: Cryptographic authentication (SHA-256 / MD5) on OSPF v2/v3 backbone interfaces
CIS_ISP_6.rationale: Prevents rogue OSPF adjacency formation and internal LSA poisoning on backbone links.
CIS_ISP_6.finding_passed: OSPF cryptographic authentication (SHA-256 or MD5) is active.
CIS_ISP_6.finding_failed: OSPF templates are operating without strong cryptographic authentication.

CIS_ISP_7.title: Disable ICMP Redirects (send-redirects=no) and IP Source Route
CIS_ISP_7.rationale: Prevents attackers from manipulating host routing tables via forged ICMP Redirect packets.
CIS_ISP_7.finding_passed: ICMP Redirects suppressed in IP Settings to mitigate MITM attacks.
CIS_ISP_7.finding_failed: Option send-redirects is enabled in general IP settings.

CIS_ISP_8.title: Disable auxiliary Web Proxy and SOCKS services (/ip/proxy and /ip/socks)
CIS_ISP_8.rationale: Prevents unauthorized open proxy abuse and traffic laundering through the router.
CIS_ISP_8.finding_passed: Auxiliary Web Proxy and SOCKS servers are disabled.
CIS_ISP_8.finding_failed: Web Proxy or SOCKS server is active without authorization.

CIS_CORP_1.title: Disable Bandwidth-Test Server (/tool/bandwidth-server) in production
CIS_CORP_1.rationale: Bandwidth-test can saturate link capacity and CPU if left enabled in production environments.
CIS_CORP_1.finding_failed: Bandwidth-Test server is enabled (CPU exhaustion risk).

CIS_CORP_2.title: Disable MAC-Telnet, MAC-WinBox and MAC-Ping on access interfaces
CIS_CORP_2.rationale: Blocks Layer-2 administrative access from untrusted corporate LAN or guest switch ports.
CIS_CORP_2.finding_passed: MAC-Server and MAC-WinBox are restricted or confined outside access ports.
CIS_CORP_2.finding_failed: MAC-Server is active across all switching interfaces.

CIS_CORP_3.title: Enforce SSH Strong Crypto (strong-crypto=yes) and disable SSH Forwarding
CIS_CORP_3.rationale: Mandates modern key exchange and ciphers while blocking unauthorized SSH port tunneling.
CIS_CORP_3.finding_passed: SSH is hardened with strong cryptography (strong-crypto=yes).
CIS_CORP_3.finding_failed: SSH allows weak cryptographic algorithms or open password access.

CIS_CORP_4.title: Enable DHCP Snooping & Option 82 on corporate LAN Bridges
CIS_CORP_4.rationale: Drops unauthorized DHCP offers from rogue devices connected to access ports.
CIS_CORP_4.finding_passed: DHCP Snooping is active on bridges to eradicate Rogue DHCP servers.
CIS_CORP_4.finding_failed: DHCP Snooping is disabled on access bridges.

CIS_CORP_5.title: Enforce SNMPv3 with SHA/AES encryption and disable v1/v2c public communities
CIS_CORP_5.rationale: Protects network telemetry and MIB trees from cleartext community string interception.
CIS_CORP_5.finding_passed: SNMPv3 USM with encryption is implemented (public v1/v2c communities eradicated).
CIS_CORP_5.finding_failed: SNMP v1/v2c communities are active without payload encryption.

CIS_CORP_6.title: Comprehensive audit streaming to Centralized Syslog (account, system,info, firewall,info)
CIS_CORP_6.rationale: Guarantees real-time streaming of authentication records, configuration modifications, and firewall drops.
CIS_CORP_6.finding_passed: Syslog audit forwarding for configuration and account events verified.
CIS_CORP_6.finding_failed: Missing logging rules for account or system,info topics towards RoSGrid Syslog.

CIS_CORP_7.title: Disable RoMON and discovery protocols (MNDP/CDP/LLDP) on user segments
CIS_CORP_7.rationale: RoMON enables out-of-band L2 bridging and discovery; must remain deactivated on untrusted user segments.
CIS_CORP_7.finding_passed: RoMON protocol is disabled on user interfaces.
CIS_CORP_7.finding_failed: RoMON is active without segment isolation.

CIS_CORP_8.title: Mandatory AES-256 encryption on binary backups and exports
CIS_CORP_8.rationale: Router backups contain credentials and network secrets; mandatory AES encryption prevents unauthorized exfiltration.
CIS_CORP_8.finding_passed: Automated binary backups are scheduled with AES-256 encryption.
CIS_CORP_8.finding_failed: No scheduled encrypted backup tasks detected.

tcp_mss_clamping_optimizer.name: TCP MSS Clamping Optimizer
tcp_mss_clamping_optimizer.description: Automatically clamps MSS in mangle to avoid fragmentation across PPPoE, GRE or WireGuard tunnels.

actualizacion_routeros_y_firmware.name: Smart RouterOS v7 & Firmware Update (CHR Auto-Detection)
actualizacion_routeros_y_firmware.description: Selects the update channel (stable, long-term, testing, development), displays the available version, and upgrades RouterOS + RouterBOOT Firmware (if CHR is detected, upgrades the OS only).

seguridad_l2_dhcp_snooping_y_option82.name: L2 Security DHCP Snooping & Option 82
seguridad_l2_dhcp_snooping_y_option82.description: Enables DHCP Snooping and Option 82 on the specified bridge and configures the uplink trunk port as Trusted to prevent Rogue DHCP servers.

huso_horario_sistema.name: System Clock & IANA Timezone (/system/clock)
huso_horario_sistema.description: Configures the official IANA system timezone (/system/clock) across the MikroTik RouterOS v7 fleet and controls IP Cloud time-zone-autodetect for accurate Syslog and WORM audit timestamps.
